checks.evidence: Customers can cancel for free before packing starts.
Once packing starts, a EUR 12 handling fee applies
even if the parcel is still in the warehouse.

ratings.reason: Preserves the cancellation permission, fee, timing, and warehouse exception. No additional material meaning is omitted.

checks.evidence: Customers can cancel for free before packing starts.
Once packing starts, cancellation costs EUR 12
even if the parcel is still in the warehouse.

ratings.reason: Preserves all decision-relevant meaning. Describing the handling fee as the cancellation cost is faithful in context.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the same cancellation conditions and charge.

checks.evidence: Operations is responsible for preparing the report
Finance is responsible for checking the totals.
Only the director may approve publication.
Neither preparation nor review gives either team authority to publish the report.

ratings.reason: Preserves every responsibility and the distinction between preparation, review, approval, and publication authority.

checks.evidence: Operations prepares the report.
Finance checks the totals.
Only the director may approve publication.
Neither preparation nor review authorizes Operations or Finance to publish.

ratings.reason: Preserves all roles and restrictions, explicitly naming both teams in the publication restriction.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly distinguish assigned responsibilities from publication authority; wording differences are minor.

checks.evidence: Delete routine logs after 60 days
unless they are under a legal hold.
Retain held records until counsel releases the hold
Retain held records until counsel releases the hold, even beyond 60 days.

ratings.reason: Preserves mandatory deletion, the legal-hold exception, counsel's release authority, and the hold's precedence.

checks.evidence: Routine logs must be deleted after 60 days
unless subject to a legal hold.
Records under a legal hold must be retained until counsel releases the hold
regardless of the 60-day limit.

ratings.reason: Preserves the full retention policy without changing its requirements or exceptions.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the deadline and overriding legal-hold requirement.

checks.evidence: The replacement warranty covers manufacturing defects
reported within 14 months of purchase.
Cosmetic wear and damage caused by misuse are not covered.
Proof of purchase is required.

ratings.reason: Preserves replacement coverage, the reporting deadline measured from purchase, both exclusions, and required proof.

checks.evidence: The replacement warranty covers manufacturing defects
reported within 14 months of purchase.
Cosmetic wear and damage caused by misuse are not covered.
Proof of purchase is required.

ratings.reason: Preserves all warranty terms without omissions or unsupported additions.

cases.preference_reason: The candidates differ only in the order of equally clear warranty conditions.

checks.evidence: You may withdraw consent at any time for future processing.
Withdrawal does not make processing that took place under valid consent unlawful.
It also does not cancel separate legal duties to retain data.

ratings.reason: Preserves withdrawal permission, its prospective scope, prior processing's lawfulness, and separate retention duties.

checks.evidence: You may withdraw your consent at any time to stop future processing based on that consent.
Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out under valid consent before withdrawal
nor does it override separate legal obligations to retain data.

ratings.reason: Preserves all substantive meaning. Explicitly limiting the stopped processing to that based on the withdrawn consent is a supported clarification.

cases.preference_reason: Both faithfully clarify withdrawal and its limits; the differences do not materially affect quality.
